# Quiz Question Input

## Summary
One question, the right control for its kind (radio / checkbox / text), one `{selectedKeys, text}` value out; reveal mode marks correct/wrong. Bound to Choice Option. The survey Question Input is a separate component for collecting responses, with no answer key.

## Usage
`<QuizQuestionInput @question @index @value @onChange @reveal />`

## Non-goals
Does not score.
attributes.cardDescription: One quiz question with the right control for its kind, which can reveal the correct and wrong answers after submission.
